symptom: `mxcli check -p` passed a script with workflow microflow actions the project's Mendix version does not have, and exec then refused it at write time, part-way: on 9.24.30 `this Mendix 9.24.30 project cannot store Microflows$NotifyWorkflowAction (Mendix 10.0.0+)` after five statements (rolled back), and with --continue-on-error the script ran on without MF_Notify, MF_GetWorkflows, MF_ActivityRecords and an `alter microflow` that inserted `get workflows`
cause: #1774 added the write-time type floor (canon.UndeclaredTypeError) for every type, but check-time MDL-VERSION01 gates only for the workflow activity and event types. No gate named a workflow microflow action, and statementVersionGates had no case for `alter microflow|nanoflow` at all, so nothing a splice inserted was ever version-gated (send email and a named lock included)
file: `mdl/executor/version_gates.go` (typeGate, workflowActionGates, microflowBodyGates, nanoflowBodyGates, the AlterFlowStmt case); `mdl/executor/cmd_alter_flow.go` (execAlterFlow calls checkVersionGates); `sdk/versions/mendix-9|10|11.yaml` (workflows.workflow_microflow_actions 9.0.2, workflow_operations 9.2.0, workflow_operation_pause_continue 9.3.0, get_workflow_data 9.10.0, workflow_operation_retry_unpause 9.12.0, notify_workflow 10.0.0, get_workflows 10.4.0, get_workflow_activity_records 10.4.0)
insight: **A write-time floor with no check-time gate is a check/exec disagreement, and the sweep is mechanical**: list the $Types the statement's converter writes (mdl/backend/modelsdk/microflow_workflow_write.go: workflowMicroflowActionToGen, workflowOperationToGen), look each up in modelsdk/canon/mendixmodelsdk_type_versions.json, and gate every floor above the lowest supported version. That is 9.0.0 (sdk/versions supported_range), and it is real: the CDN lists mxbuild 9.0.0 and 9.0.1 builds (`curl 'https://cdn.mendix.com/?list-type=2&prefix=runtime/mxbuild-9.0.'`), so the 9.0.2 actions (call workflow, set task outcome, open user task, open workflow) are gated too. A workflow operation writes two types, the action (9.2) and the operation (abort/restart 9.2, pause/continue 9.3, retry/unpause 9.12): the floor is the later. **Keep the floor in sdk/versions and pin it, rather than reading canon at check time**: every gate reads the registry, `show features` lists it, and the message's version comes from it; a gate that read canon would be a second mechanism, and the yaml row could still drift from it. TestTypeGates_FloorIsTheTypeIntroduction pins each type gate's row (the #1774 ones too) to canon.TypeIntroduced of the types it names, at the exact boundary (available at the floor, not just below it). The migration reference does not read the yaml, so `check-migration-reference` is unaffected. **Lock and unlock (9.21) need no gate of their own**: every lock or unlock that check and exec accept names its workflow, and that selection is the 10.0 workflowDefinitionSelectionGate. **`alter microflow` had no version gate at all**: a body gate added for `create microflow` must reach the splice, so share one function (microflowBodyGates) and apply it to every operation's fragment; execAlterFlow calls it too, for exec without the pre-flight. `create or modify` needs nothing new: it is a CreateMicroflowStmt, gated on its whole declared body, and its splices do not go through execAlterFlow. **The mxbuild class-name oracle agrees**: `strings -a Mendix*.dll | tr -c 'A-Za-z0-9_\n' '\n' | sort -u` on 9.24.30 lacks NotifyWorkflowAction, GetWorkflowsAction and GetWorkflowActivityRecordsAction and has every other action and operation (ResumeOperation too, kept to load older models); 10.24.24 has all. Measured with the bug-test: on 9.24.30 before, check -p passed the script without its 10.0 workflow and exec refused it at write time; after, check -p and exec's pre-flight report MF_Notify (10.0), MF_GetWorkflows, MF_ActivityRecords and the alter (10.4), App.mpr is byte-identical, mx check 0 errors; the 9.0.2-9.12 actions, written with --no-check, load on 9.24 with 0 errors. 10.24.24 before and after: check -p clean, exec writes everything, mx check 0 errors. Control: without the table's gates in microflowBodyGates, the 70 create and 140 alter below-floor cases report nothing; a row moved off its type's introduction fails the pin test; without execAlterFlow's call, exec reports `microflow not found` instead of the refusal. Tests: version_gates_workflow_actions_1787_test.go; mdl-examples/bug-tests/1787-workflow-actions-below-their-version.mdl
